headline: Sealed 1977 Star Wars cards up for auction
post:
Calling all Star Wars collectors! A sealed box of 1977 Topps Series 1 trading cards is currently up for auction at Heritage Auctions. 

This unopened box features 36 packs and could hold multiple copies of the iconic #1 Luke Skywalker card, which has previously sold for record-breaking sums. Other rare finds like the Han Solo and Darth Vader cards could also fetch big money!

How much would you pay to have the chance of finding those rarest cards?

#StarWars #TradingCards #Collectibles
original_title: A New Star Wars Trading Card Auction Could Be a Gamble Worth Millions, but You Will Never Know Unless You Win It

headline: Krakoa gains Cyclops and Colossus powers
post:
Hey X-Men fans, a brand new crossover just dropped a massive twist for our favorite mutants! According to Screen Rant, Marvel has officially introduced a brand new hero version of Krakoa in "Godzilla Conquers the Multiverse #4" from Gerry Duggan, Javier Garrón, David Curiel and Travis Lanham. 🏝️

In this issue, Emma Frost calls on assistance from "Universe M," a reality where the mutant nation of the same name never fell. This living island feeds on mutant power in a controlled symbiosis and now wields the abilities of major characters including Wolverine, Jean Grey, Magneto, Cyclops, and Colossus.

This introduction also marks the first confirmation of an ongoing alternate reality where the Krakoa Era continued instead of ending. It opens up exciting possibilities for future stories in this timeline. What other mutant abilities do you hope to see this living island harness next? 

#XMen #MarvelComics #Krakoa
original_title: X-Men's New Hero Officially Combines Powers of Cyclops and Colossus

headline: Green Lantern #40: DC reboots classic villain
post:
Hey everyone! Big DC news just dropped. According to Screen Rant, DC has confirmed it is rebooting a classic Green Lantern villain for a new storyline. 

In Green Lantern #40, written by Jeremy Adams and drawn by Scott Godlewski and Vasco Georgiev, a surprising new Black Hand is chosen. At the end of the issue, someone presumably Nekron summons Alexandra DeWitt. The former girlfriend of Kyle Rayner rises from the muck, and Nekron tells Alexandra that her pain has been "found worthy." 

DeWitt only made a handful of appearances before her tragic death early in Kyle's career. Now, she returns as the latest incarnation of Black Hand. Nekron reportedly uses her justified anger to corrupt her and turn her into a pawn. This shocking twist will definitely test Kyle Rayner and the united multicolored Lantern Corps! 

Are you reading the latest Green Lantern issues? 

#GreenLantern #DCComics #KyleRayner
original_title: DC Confirms It's Rebooting Classic Villain for Next Green Lantern Appearance

headline: Vintage Star Wars toy prices soar today
post:
Collecting vintage Star Wars items from Kenner has become quite costly for many enthusiasts. An old catalog page shared on Reddit revealed that a classic X-Wing was originally priced much lower than current eBay and Hasbro Pulse rates.

With both vintage and modern figures requiring a significant financial investment, a number of collectors have reportedly been priced out of the hobby over the years.

#StarWars #Kenner #Toys
original_title: Vintage Star Wars Toy Prices Have Resurfaced and Fans Can’t Believe How Unaffordable the Hobby Is Today
